images.title: Fill the missing term with one factor
images.purpose: Shows the ratio table in its simplest state: 4 : 9 scaled by 3 to fill the missing term 27.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A two-row, two-column ratio table in the centre with one factor arrow on each row.
images.exact_structure: A table of two rows and two columns with thin dark lines. First column: 4 on top, 9 below, in teal (#0072B2). Second column: 12 on top in teal, and below it the filled missing cell 27, that cell outlined thick in reddish purple (#CC79A7). Exactly two curved amber (#E69F00) arrows from the first column to the second, one above the top row and one below the bottom row, each labelled × 3. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Find the factor from the full row, 12 ÷ 4 = 3, and use it on the other row: 9 × 3 = 27.
images.description: Shows the ratio table in its simplest state: 4 : 9 scaled by 3 to fill the missing term 27.
images.context: 4 : 9 :: 12 : 27, one of the proportional ratios to 4 : 9.

image_decisions.why: The tool's core move, one factor carried to both rows, in its plainest state.
